title: The Periodic Table
text: The periodic table organizes all known chemical elements by increasing atomic number, arranged so elements with similar chemical properties fall in the same column (group). It has 18 groups and 7 periods. Elements are broadly classified as metals, nonmetals, and metalloids. The table, first arranged by Dmitri Mendeleev in 1869, allows scientists to predict the properties of elements based on their position, including reactivity, electronegativity, and atomic radius.
